packet.headline_seed: Jimmy Kimmel rejects White House criticism over Melania widow joke
packet.description_seed: In a parody aired days before the White House Correspondents' Dinner, Kimmel called Melania an "expectant widow".

what: Jimmy Kimmel rejects White House criticism over Melania widow joke

clean_source_blocks.text: In a parody aired days before the White House Correspondents' Dinner, Kimmel called Melania an "expectant widow".
Late-night host Jimmy Kimmel has defended a joke in which he called Melania Trump an "expectant widow" just days before a shooting incident at the White House Correspondents' Dinner.

Late-night host Jimmy Kimmel dared to repeat the “hateful” ill-timed joke he made about first lady Melania Trump looking like an “expectant widow” in a bombed roast he delivered days before the shooting at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner.
Nancy Mace has criticized Jimmy Kimmel over his remarks about the White House Correspondents’ Dinner last week.
